title: Reviews
description: What patients wrote after their visit

help.title: About reviews
help.overview: A patient can leave one review from the link in their appointment email once the visit is completed. It shows at once on your clinic's site and as stars on the portal.

sections.title: On this page
items: You cannot change, hide or delete a review. If one breaks the rules, report it to the platform from its menu.
An appointment can have only one review.
A review shows the patient's first name and the initial of their last name.
